insert into ai_copilot_feedback
record_id, session_id, agent_id, agent_name, dept_id, suggestion_type, suggestion_ref, action, create_time
#{recordId}, #{sessionId}, #{agentId}, #{agentName}, #{deptId}, #{suggestionType}, #{suggestionRef}, #{action}, now()
mapper.select: select count(*) as total, sum(case when action = 'ADOPT' then 1 else 0 end) as adoptCount, sum(case when action = 'MODIFY' then 1 else 0 end) as modifyCount, sum(case when action = 'IGNORE' then 1 else 0 end) as ignoreCount from ai_copilot_feedback where create_time >= #{beginTime} and create_time < #{endTime}

select agent_id as agentId, max(agent_name) as agentName, max(dept_id) as deptId, count(*) as total, sum(case when action = 'ADOPT' then 1 else 0 end) as adoptCount, sum(case when action = 'MODIFY' then 1 else 0 end) as modifyCount, sum(case when action = 'IGNORE' then 1 else 0 end) as ignoreCount from ai_copilot_feedback where create_time >= #{beginTime} and create_time < #{endTime} and agent_id is not null group by agent_id order by total desc
